about: Golden set for search ranking (spec 15.2 golden.test.cjs, T-17 scope of B6). Synthetic notes for a made-up team. Phase 1 (exact) must find each exact-word question's file first; phase 2 (broad) must find every question's file first, including the reworded ones that phase 1 misses.

notes.ops/rollback-plan.md:
# Rollback plan

If a release goes wrong, run the rollback script. It restores the previous build and takes the service back to the last good version.
notes.ops/deploy-checklist.md:
# Deploy checklist

Before each deploy: run the tests, tag the build, and post in the team channel. The deploy runs from the release pipeline.
notes.ops/incident-review.md:
# Incident review

After every incident we hold a short review. We write down what broke, how we found it, and one change that stops it from happening again.
notes.ops/hotfix-flow.md:
# Hotfix flow

A hotfix goes straight to the main branch. If it fails, roll the change back at once and open a new ticket.
notes.ops/on-call.md:
# On-call rota

Each week one person holds the pager. Hand over the pager on Monday morning with a short summary of open alerts.
notes.ops/monitoring.md:
# Monitoring

Dashboards show error rates and response times for every service. Alerts page the on-call person when a rate stays high for five minutes.
notes.db/backup-restore.md:
# Backup and restore

The database backup runs every night. To restore, pick the newest backup, load it into a spare server, and check the row counts before switching over.
notes.db/schema-changes.md:
# Schema changes

Each table is migrated in one step. Old columns stay until every reader has moved to the new layout.
notes.db/postgres-tuning.md:
# Postgres tuning

Raise the connection limit slowly and watch memory. Vacuum the large ones weekly.
notes.db/read-replicas.md:
# Read replicas

Reports run against a read replica so the main database keeps up with writes.
notes.security/certificate-renewal.md:
# Certificate renewal

Web certificates expire every ninety days. The renewal job runs weekly and warns the team when a certificate has less than two weeks left.
notes.security/access-review.md:
# Access review

Every quarter, each team lead checks who can reach the production systems and removes anyone who no longer needs it.
notes.security/dependency-updates.md:
# Dependency updates

A bot opens a request for each outdated package. Merge the small ones weekly; read the change notes for major versions first.
notes.team/onboarding.md:
# Onboarding

A new starter gets a laptop on the first day, an account for the wiki, and a buddy for the first two weeks. The onboarding list lives in this note.
notes.team/vacation-policy.md:
# Vacation policy

Book vacation in the shared calendar at least two weeks ahead. Leave longer than ten days needs a sign-off from your lead.
notes.team/meeting-notes.md:
# Weekly meeting

We meet on Tuesdays. Each person gives a short update; blockers go to the end of the meeting.
notes.team/code-review.md:
# Code review

Every change gets one review before it merges. Reviewers look for tests, clear names, and a short description.
notes.team/writing-style.md:
# Writing style

Use short sentences and plain words. Put the answer first, then the reasons.
notes.web/cache-invalidation.md:
# Cache invalidation

When a page changes, the publish step sends an invalidation for its path. A full invalidation is a last resort because the cache then refills from scratch.
notes.web/page-layout.md:
# Page layout

The header holds the logo and the menu. The footer holds the link to the help page and the legal notes.
notes.web/forms.md:
# Forms

Every form checks its fields in the browser and again on the server. Error text sits next to the field it belongs to.
notes.api/versioning.md:
# API versioning

The API carries its version in the path. An old version stays live for six months after the next one ships.
notes.api/rate-limits.md:
# Rate limits

Each client may send a fixed number of requests per minute. Over the limit, the API answers with a retry hint.
notes.api/error-codes.md:
# Error codes

Every error reply holds a short code and a plain message. Codes never change once published.
notes.delivery/ci-pipeline.md:
# CI pipeline

The CI pipeline runs lint, unit tests and a build on every push. A red pipeline blocks the merge.
notes.delivery/release-branches.md:
# Release branches

Cut a release branch a week before the launch. Only fixes go onto it after that.
notes.delivery/test-data.md:
# Test data

Tests build their own data at run time. No real customer data is ever copied into a test.
notes.product/release-notes.md:
# Release notes

Each release gets short notes in plain words: what changed, who it helps, and anything users must do.
notes.product/roadmap.md:
# Roadmap

The roadmap lists the next three themes. Dates are rough and move when the team learns more.
notes.product/feedback.md:
# Customer feedback

Feedback from support calls goes into one board. Each item is tagged by theme once a week.
notes.finance/invoice-process.md:
# Invoice process

Each invoice is checked against the order, approved by the budget owner, and paid within thirty days.
notes.finance/payroll.md:
# Payroll

Payroll closes on the twentieth of each month. Changes after that date move to the next month.
notes.finance/budget.md:
# Budget

Each team gets a yearly budget. Spending over the plan needs a short written reason.
notes.infra/cluster-setup.md:
# Cluster setup

The cluster runs on kubernetes with three worker nodes. New nodes join through the setup script.
notes.infra/dns.md:
# DNS records

DNS changes go through a reviewed request. Keep the time to live short before a planned move.
notes.infra/network.md:
# Network

The office network and the server network are kept apart. Only the gateway joins them.
notes.infra/storage.md:
# Storage

Files older than a year move to cold storage. Restoring from cold storage takes several hours.
notes.support/help-desk.md:
# Help desk

The help desk answers within one working day. Urgent issues go to the on-call person.
notes.support/known-issues.md:
# Known issues

This list holds bugs we know about and the workaround for each. Remove an entry once its fix ships.
notes.misc/glossary.md:
# Glossary

A rollout is a staged release. A canary is the first small group that gets a release.
